messages:
alex: Quick weekly LuminaPay check-in — noticed error rate jump. Overall error rate 3.2% this week vs 1.4% last week. Spike window ~2026-03-20 10:30–11:15 PST. Can SRE confirm breakdown (5xx/timeouts/rate limits) + top failing endpoints?

maria: Looking now. Preliminary: of the errors in the spike window -> 5xx ~65%, timeouts ~25%, rate-limits ~10%. Most 5xx are 502/503 from model backend, not our gateway.

ben: FYI LuminaPay is mid-onboarding — they hit the integration success checks this morning and some steps failed. This could impact their enablement milestones / renewal signal.

ops-bot: Alert summary for account=lumina_01: 4 critical alerts in 45m (api-errors high, avg-rt > 2s), 12 warning alerts. See https://internal.ops/alerts/1854321876

maria: Top failing paths (24h agg):
1) /v1/generate (45% of failing requests)
2) /v1/chat/completions (22%)
3) /v1/embeddings (18%)
4) /v1/reply-stream (8%)
others include /v1/healthcheck noisy from their CI.

maria: Query I used (clickhouse-ish):
```
SELECT path, status_family, count() as cnt
FROM requests
WHERE account_id='lumina_01' AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL 24 hour
GROUP BY path, status_family
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 20
```

alex: Thanks. Any indication whether the 5xxs are rate-related downstream (model timeouts) or infra?

maria: Digging traces — most 5xx correlate with model backend errors (503) returned after long queue times. We also see a surge of heavy-context calls to /v1/generate with sequence lengths ~6k tokens which spikes compute and queues.

priya: LuminaPay mentioned they rolled out a batching integration yesterday (sdk v1.4.3). They also switched to high-context prompts for the fraud-detection branch. Might be correlated.

ben: If onboarding pipelines timeout, customers drop off. I'm flagging renewal-risk if we don't stabilize within 48h. Can we get mitigations ASAP?

maria: Immediate mitigations we can do:
- Apply a temporary token-based rate cap per project for lumina_01 (limit burst)
- Set a canary routing to lower-cost model variant for their traffic during spike windows
- Add prefix KV cache for repeated system prompts

alex: Assign owners?

maria: I'll take the rate cap + routing change. ETA 90m to push canary and monitor.

priya: I'll ask LuminaPay to rollback sdk v1.4.3 to v1.4.1 for the next 24h and reduce max_context to 2k tokens on the fraud branch. I can push a config snippet to them.

ben: I'll reach out to LuminaPay PM and engineering to coordinate rollback and set expectation for onboarding timeline.

maria: Quick reproduction curl I used for load sampling:
```
for i in {1..20}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer x" -d '{"prompt":"<6k tokens>...","max_tokens":512}'; done
```

ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-4321 for LuminaPay spike. Linked to this thread.

alex: Action items:
- maria -> deploy per-account burst cap + canary routing (90m)
- priya -> ask LuminaPay to rollback SDK + reduce context (30m)
- ben -> customer comms + update onboarding timeline (60m)
- maria -> post follow-up metrics in this thread after canary (after 90m)

priya: Sending rollback request to LuminaPay now. cc @ben

maria: Pushed canary routing to 10% for lumina_01 at 11:45 PST. Early signal: error-rate on canary 1.1% vs 3.2% on default. Watching.

ben: Meeting to sync at 14:00 PST? 20m to align on customer comms.

alex: Yes, 14:00 works. Please drop updates here before meeting.

maria: Will post metrics snapshot in ~60m.

ben: Noted — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
